name: Salxire
source:
Salxire, a staunch creative, keeps in comfortable contact with the other fellow rebellious creatures of the slum via a daily routine of card games. 

She is ambitious but not conscientious, with a creativity that's been stilted for some time, now. 

[From [url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/seraphim-slum]itch.io[/url]]
